# Couriers

Worked from the owner's rate sheet.

| Courier | Price per parcel | Delivery time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Swiftline | $11.90 | 2 to 4 business days |
| Parcelbird | $10.40 | 1 to 2 business days |
| Roadrunner Freight | $8.90 | 4 to 7 business days |

## Recommendation

Move to Parcelbird. It is the fastest of the three and includes tracking. It also costs $1.50 less a parcel than Swiftline.

Roadrunner Freight has the lowest price. It is the slowest and has no tracking, so complaints would rise.
